settings.title: MyoLift App Membership
settings.content: The difference between the MyoLift QT+ Base and Premium memberships is reflected in the MyoLift Smart App experience. With the Base Membership, you receive a 30-day free trial to all Premium app features. After the trial ends, the Base Membership provides access to App-Free Mode and My QT Plan only. Most treatment options within the “Sessions”menu will be locked, as these are part of the Premium features. The Premium Membership unlocks full access to all guided treatments, advanced sessions, and app features designed to maximize your MyoLift results

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
Step 1: Clarify – Cleanse skin using the Mangosteen Cleanser to prep for maximum microcurrent conductivity.
Step 2: Boost – Apply the ATP Booster Gel to energize the skin and enhance treatment effectiveness.
Step 3: Treat – Choose your microcurrent application based on the day:

  • Sheet Mask: Days 1, 8, 14
  • Conductive Gloves: Days 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13
  • 2 Hands-Free Masks with Splitter Wire: Days 3, 5, 10, 12
    Step 4: Target – Apply the Eye Lift Serum to address fine lines and puffiness around the eyes.
    Step 5: Nourish – Lock in moisture and enhance post-treatment glow with the Anti-Aging Peptide Serum.

Note: Steps 1, 2, 4, and 5 remain consistent throughout the 14-day program. Step 3 alternates based on the treatment schedule above.

settings.heading: Why You'll Love It?
settings.section_content: The Wrinkle Boost Skincare Kit delivers an advanced, multi-step treatment designed to target fine lines, wrinkles, and loss of firmness through a potent blend of peptides, mangosteen, and ATP-boosting ingredients. Paired with the MyoLift microcurrent device, it stimulates collagen production, improves skin elasticity, and enhances cellular energy for a visibly smoother, firmer, and more youthful appearance. This comprehensive kit rejuvenates your skin’s texture while deeply hydrating and supporting long-term skin health.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What age group is this kit recommended for?
settings.text1: It’s perfect for anyone experiencing fine lines, wrinkles, or loss of firmness—typically mid-30s and up, but preventative use is also encouraged.
settings.title2: What makes this kit more advanced than the others?
settings.text2: It includes the most targeted ingredients (peptides, EGF, ATP booster, conductive gloves) and a 5-step protocol focused on wrinkle reduction and skin regeneration.
settings.title3: Can I skip a step or two if I’m short on time?
settings.text3: While every step has its benefit, steps 1, 2, 4, and 5 are crucial. You can modify the treatment method (Step 3) based on your schedule.
settings.title4: Will it help with under-eye wrinkles and puffiness?
settings.text4: Yes. The included Eye Lift Serum is formulated specifically for the delicate eye area and works in tandem with the masks and device.
settings.title5: How soon can I expect visible results?
settings.text5: Most users report noticeable improvements in firmness and texture within the 14-day program, with best results after consistent use.
